claims.claim: Cyril of Alexandria was a Christian theologian and bishop active in the complex doctrinal struggles of the 5th century.
Cyril succeeded his uncle Theophilus as bishop of the see of Alexandria in 412.
The homily was delivered in the church of Cyrinus on the thirteenth of the month Phamenoth according to the Egyptian calendar.
In the homily, Cyril interprets the saying from Isaiah: 'Death swallowed up when he had prevailed, and again God wiped away every tear from every face.'
Cyril is chiefly known for his campaign against Nestorius, bishop of Constantinople, whose views on Christ's nature were to be declared heretical.
Cyril was named a Doctor of the Church by Pope Leo XIII in 1883 under the title Doctor Incarnationis ('Doctor of the Incarnation').
